description:
Describe deployment.json schema 2 (recommended): applications with
        launch kind app/instance/studio, equipment_writes read-only/operator/
        automatic, restart policy and depends_on, plus services (private
        loopback MQTT broker, command services with readiness probes, TCP
        checks) and the local launcher (lazyanalysis --launch, File > Open
        deployment, systemd/Windows logon installers). Schema 1 is still
        described. This server cannot provision, execute deployments, access
        credentials or grant equipment writes.
        Example: describe_deployment_bundle() before writing a .lazydeploy for prepare_deployment_bundle.
name: describe_deployment_bundle
title: Describe the deployment description and launcher
